reportedIssues: The badge on the pizza card in 'Popular right now' reads '−100%', implying the item is entirely free. This looks like a data/formatting bug (e.g., a percentage computed or sign-flipped incorrectly) and undermines trust in the promotions shown.

The favorite/heart control is styled inconsistently between cards: on the ramen card the heart sits on the dark image with no visible circular backdrop, while on the pizza card it has a distinct dark translucent circle. This makes the same control look like two different components.

The 'Fastest near you' cards use very different image treatments (the first tile is a pale, low-contrast illustration on light gray while the others are dark photographic-style images), making the row look visually uneven and the white time pill on the light tile nearly blends into the background.

expected.reasoning: Reported issue 0 describes the same '−100%' discount badge on the pizza card as the expected defect.
